title: Sarp Shaders
description: A cozy shaderpack, soft light, moody skies, living water.
body: A shaderpack I've been building for myself, tuned the way I actually like Minecraft to look — soft light, moody skies, and water that's fun to stare at. Runs on Iris / OptiFine. ![v1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LvtQEwjR/images/45f015aff73c5c1eea6857719c9a5e48f661c180.webp) ## What's inside - **Physical sky** with volumetric clouds, cloud shadows and volumetric light shafts - **Water that behaves** — waves, refraction, caustics, foam and screen-space reflections - **Soft colored shadows** and SSAO for that grounded, cozy feel - **PBR support** with auto-generated normals if your resource pack doesn't have them - **Aurora** at night and a custom **nebula in the End** - The usual camera goodies: bloom, auto exposure, FXAA, saturation control ![v2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LvtQEwjR/images/e804603b651c67a354397303200ce377ddad62e6.png) ## Installation 1. Grab the latest release 2. Drop the folder into your `shaderpacks` directory 3. Select **Sarp Shaders** in the video settings and you're done Everything is tweakable in the shader options menu — shadows, lighting, water, atmosphere and camera each have their own screen. ## Notes This is a personal project, so expect opinionated defaults. If something looks off on your setup, poke around the settings before opening an issue — chances are there's a slider for it. --- *Made by Sarp. Screenshots welcome — I'd love to see your builds with it.*
